summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong listing rules, detailing share repurchases for cancellation from March 20 to April 15, 2026. The company bought back and held for cancellation a total of over 10 million Class A ordinary shares at prices ranging from roughly $6.57 to $7.14 per share, representing up to ~0.08% of outstanding per tranche. The board implicitly authorized the buyback program; no advisors or break fees are named. The disclosure is a routine report of ongoing capital return activities. Watch for the pace of future cancellations and potential impact on earnings per share.
